summary.text: Jeff Ellington is the Republican candidate for Indiana State Senate District 39 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former Indiana House member, he represented District 62 from 2016 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Ellington, a long-time Bloomington resident, worked as a rescue technician at the local fire department and was retired as of 2020.
He also served on the Monroe County Council and as Monroe County recorder.
Ellington represented Indiana House District 62 from 2016 to 2022, winning re-election in 2018 and 2020.
In 2021 and 2022 he was assigned to the Financial Institutions and Insurance (as vice chair), Local Government, and Natural Resources committees.
He lost the May 2022 Republican primary for House District 45 to incumbent Bruce Borders and lost to Borders again in the 2024 primary.
In 2026 he won the Republican primary for Senate District 39, defeating Kristi Risk and Tanner Bouchie.
